h1: iOS feature work for your existing app
overview: Send us your repository and a short brief, and we add the feature or fix the bug in your current app. We read your code first, follow your structure and naming, build the change on a separate branch and test it on real devices and several iOS versions. You get a pull request with notes, so your team can review and merge it. We do not rewrite what already works.

Design matched to your current app

faq: What access do you need to my code?
A repository invite, such as GitHub or Bitbucket, and the steps to build the app. We work on a branch and never push to your main branch. We never ask for passwords.
What if the codebase is old or messy?
We read it before we start. If a safe change needs bigger repairs, we tell you what and why, and keep the work to what you ordered. Large refactors are quoted separately.
Can you fix a crash I cannot reproduce?
We try. With crash logs from Xcode, TestFlight or a crash tool, we can often trace the cause. Without logs, a fix may only reduce the risk, and we say so clearly.
Do you work with UIKit as well as SwiftUI?
Yes. We follow what your app already uses and mix the two where it makes sense. We do not convert your whole app unless you order that as a separate job.
